newsitem.title: PANAMA: SOCCER-DELY VALDES TO STAY AT PSG TILL 1998.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DELY VALDES TO STAY AT PSG TILL 1998.

text.p: Panama's top soccer player Julio Cesar Dely Valdes says he is likely to stay with French league leaders Paris St Germain until 1998, deflating rumours of a possible transfer or loan to a Brazilian club.
He told reporters at the weekend that he recently declined a $3-million offer from Sao Paulo's Corinthians.
Dely Valdes said the Brazilians contacted him on September 22 after a World Cup qualifier between Panama and Cuba.
"Then they came to Paris and we talked it out," the 29-year-old striker said during a reception in his honour at the French embassy in Panama City.
"PSG said they would allow me to play with them for one year but the Brazilians didn't accept the deal. They wanted me to play right away and for more time."
Stressing he intended to stay with PSG until the end of his contract in 1998, he said Corinthians were now trying to woo his twin brother Jorge who plays in Japan.
Dely Valdes played in Panama's 1-1 draw against El Salvador in a World Cup qualifier on Sunday.
